name: 27418-imageprefill-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine (`--distributed-executor-backend uni`), served through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16: a ~7B text decoder behind a 32-layer vision tower with a 2x2 spatial merge; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json and preprocessor_config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=2, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 200 requests (160 after warmup) with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn image prefill, one image per request: guidellm `synthetic_text` (64 prompt tokens, min = max) composed with `synthetic_image` (`resolution: 1080p` -> 1920x1080 JPEG, quality 85, `content: noise`, seed 27418), and exactly 8 generated tokens with EOS ignored. Every image is byte-distinct. The engine's own prompt-token count reads far above 64 because the image expands into placeholder tokens under the chat template; that is not drift.
purpose: A vision assistant captioning single full-HD photos with brief replies for two concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's launch configuration. Every key here is pinned explicitly rather than inherited,
# so a change of engine default cannot move it. Anything not listed is the engine default.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
# Must match scenario.json's images_per_request: it is both the admission limit and what the
# start-up profiling pass is sized against. Keep it on ONE line -- the engine's own reader skips
# indented lines, so re-flowing it into a block mapping drops the key silently.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1, "video": 0}
enable-prefix-caching: false
distributed-executor-backend: uni
tensor-parallel-size: 1
